hero_kpi_rationale: Key operational performance metric defined as Operating Revenues minus fuel, purchased supply, and direct transmission costs, excluding depreciation. A non-GAAP measure preferred by management to analyze financial performance while neutralizing energy cost volatility.

risks.title: Imperfect recovery of regulated costs
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, mention of past disallowances (30.9M$ by MPSC in 2025), strong language on rate-making imprudence risk, highly weighted category in regulated utilities.

risks.title: Costly environmental compliance
risks.score_rationale: Repeated presence with risks on CO2 emissions, unstable EPA rules, impacted projects (e.g. YCGS), alarming language on unrecovered costs.

risks.title: Litigation delays key projects
risks.score_rationale: Concrete example with temporary cancellation of YCGS permit in 2023, three-month construction halt, additional costs, explicit mention of similar future risks.

risks.title: Mandatory high-cost purchases (QF)
risks.score_rationale: Frequently and thoroughly mentioned, impact on investment flexibility, uncontrolled replacement costs, risk of customer surcharges and non-recovery.

risks.title: Penalties for non-compliance reliability
risks.score_rationale: Risk of penalties up to 1.2M$ per day per NERC/FERC violation, mention of increased sanctions, potential material impact on results.

risks.title: Energy transition risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in financial and operational risks, linkage to public policies, emerging technologies and fossil assets (e.g. Colstrip), risk of obsolescence.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and physical threats
risks.score_rationale: Included in critical operational risks, reference to NERC CIP standards, risk of major disruption, preventive but alarming language.

ai_positioning.summary: NWE does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F filing.
